'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Jerry Heine LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Username:''' quesosauce37
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
